clips.title: Why He Agreed to Appear on Camera
grammar: 〜てもいい — permission / it is okay to...
〜てもおかしくない — wouldn't be strange if...

lines.ja: なんで突然さ、出てもいいよって言ったのか気になってて
lines.en: I was wondering why you suddenly said it's okay to appear on video.
lines.speaker: Woman

lines.ja: いつ死んでもおかしくない歳になった。だから動画を残すだけでもいいかなと…
lines.en: I've reached an age where dying anytime wouldn't be surprising. So I figured leaving some videos behind would be nice...
lines.speaker: Man

lines.ja: 話が暗すぎて怖いんですけど…そうなんだ。
lines.en: That's way too dark, it's scary... But I see.
lines.speaker: Woman

clips.title: Disappearing at the Cash Register
grammar: 〜になると — when it comes to / whenever it becomes

lines.ja: Ｈ＆Ｍも、１００均でもさ、レジで行方不明になるじゃん…見事！
lines.en: At H&M and the 100-yen shop, you always go missing at the register... Truly impressive!
lines.speaker: Woman

lines.ja: 何でレジになるといなくなるの？
lines.en: Why do you always disappear when it's time for the register?
lines.speaker: Woman

clips.title: Debating Expiration Dates
grammar: 〜っつったって — casual form of 〜と言ったって (even if you say...)

lines.ja: 時々冷蔵庫の中がさ、キレイになってるの。
lines.en: Sometimes the inside of the fridge becomes all clean.
lines.speaker: Woman

lines.ja: 賞味期限切れてたら捨てるよ。
lines.en: If something has expired, I throw it away.
lines.speaker: Man

lines.ja: 開封後は早めにお召し上がりくださいって書いてあるじゃん。
lines.en: It says, "Please consume promptly after opening," doesn't it?
lines.speaker: Man

lines.ja: 早めっつったって１年なのかさ、５年なのか全く分かんないじゃん。
lines.en: Even if it says "promptly," you have no idea if that means 1 year or 5 years!
lines.speaker: Woman
